# Windows (x86_64) "engines" venv -- the mirror of requirements_engines_mac.txt
# for the Windows kit. Same pinned versions; the ONLY difference is torch:
#
# torch/torchaudio are NOT listed here. On Windows, plain PyPI torch is the
# CPU-only wheel, so the CUDA build is installed separately from the pytorch.org
# cu128 index by installSpec.js (buildSteps: torchCuda) BEFORE this file. That
# keeps GPU acceleration while letting these packages resolve normally.

# Local Demucs source separation (app/scripts/demucs_separate.py).
demucs==4.1.0

# Local Whisper transcription (app/scripts/whisper_transcribe.py).
faster-whisper==1.2.1

# The laughter/breath whitelist (app/nonverbal.py) shells out to the ORIGINAL
# openai-whisper (~140MB "base", fetched on first use).
openai-whisper

# Local CAM++ diarization + Qwen take scoring.
onnxruntime==1.27.0
scikit-learn==1.9.0
scipy==1.17.1
soundfile==0.14.0
numpy==2.4.6

# --- Voice synthesis (merged from the former requirements_qwen_win.txt, 2026-09) ---
# One engines venv now serves separation, transcription, diarization, the
# take scorer AND the Qwen3-TTS sidecar (sidecar/server.py, a small FastAPI
# app). The shared pins above (torch, onnxruntime, numpy, soundfile) were
# already identical in both lists, verified by pip --dry-run before merging.
fastapi
uvicorn[standard]
python-multipart
qwen-tts==0.1.1
accelerate==1.12.0
einops==0.8.2
gradio==6.17.3
librosa==0.11.0
